lines.say: Ionic bonding is the attraction between opposite ions in a lattice.
Making the ions costs energy. The payoff is the large lattice energy.
Attraction goes as charge times charge over distance. Higher charges, smaller ions, stronger lattice.
So magnesium oxide melts near 2850 degrees, but sodium chloride at 801.

draw.alt: Melting points: MgO bar far taller than NaCl

lines.say: In metals, cations sit in a sea of delocalised electrons. That's why metals conduct.
A covalent bond is a shared pair of electrons, attracted to two nuclei.
Count the valence electrons. Add one for each negative charge.
Put the least electronegative atom in the middle, never hydrogen. Join with single bonds.
Fill outer octets, then the centre. Short? Make multiple bonds.
Exceptions: B F 3 has six electrons. S F 6 has an expanded octet of 12.
Formal charge: valence electrons, minus lone pair electrons, minus half the bonding ones.
In H C N, every formal charge is zero. In H N C, nitrogen is plus 1 and carbon minus 1.

draw.alt: HCN with zero formal charges versus HNC with +1 and -1

lines.say: Nitrate can be drawn three equivalent ways. These are resonance structures.
The real ion is one hybrid. All three bonds are equal, bond order four thirds.
It doesn't flip between structures. Benzene's six bonds are all 139 picometres.
Bond energy is the energy to break one mole of a bond in the gas phase.
Higher bond order: shorter and stronger. C C single, double, triple.

draw.alt: C-C bonds get shorter and stronger with bond order

lines.say: Delta H is roughly bonds broken minus bonds formed.
For burning methane: 2652 broken, 3460 formed.
So delta H is about minus 808. The measured value is about minus 802.
Electronegativity is how strongly an atom pulls shared electrons. Fluorine is top at 4.0.
Unequal sharing gives a polar bond, with partial charges.

draw.alt: Polar O-H bond with electrons pulled towards oxygen

lines.say: It's a continuum: non polar, polar covalent, then mainly ionic. No bond is fully ionic.
Head on overlap gives a sigma bond. Side on overlap of p orbitals gives a pi bond.
A double bond is one sigma plus one pi. A triple is one sigma plus two pi.
Count electron domains. A multiple bond counts as one.
sp 3 is tetrahedral, 109.5 degrees. sp 2 is 120. sp is linear, 180.

draw.alt: Tetrahedral, trigonal planar and linear shapes

lines.say: In C H 3 C N there are 5 sigma bonds and 2 pi bonds.
Resonance structures don't switch back and forth. There's one real hybrid.
Formal charge isn't oxidation number.
It's bonds broken minus bonds formed. Don't reverse it.
A double bond isn't twice a single. 614 is less than 692.
